name: parse_github_url
title: Parse a remote git repo specification

origin.description: Parse an HTTPS, SSH, or browser URL for a GitHub repository.
origin.details: The URL contains a github host, then a username and repository. tree, commit, and releases/tag set ref. pull sets pull. Another releases path sets release, and latest is stored as *release. When ref, pull, and release are empty, a repository that ends in .git loses that suffix. The search is not anchored, so the host can sit inside a longer string. Anything that does not match stops with Invalid GitHub URL: '<repo>'.
origin.value: A list with username, repo, ref, pull, and release. A member the URL omits is an empty string.

translation.description: Parse an HTTPS, SSH, or browser URL for a GitHub repository.
translation.details: The URL contains a github host, then a username and repository. tree, commit, and releases/tag set ref. pull sets pull. Another releases path sets release, and latest is stored as *release. When ref, pull, and release are empty, a repository that ends in .git loses that suffix. That check is the end of the string, so a final newline keeps .git. The search is not anchored, so the host can sit inside a longer string. Anything that does not match raises Invalid GitHub URL: '<repo>'.
translation.value: A dict with username, repo, ref, pull, and release. A member the URL omits is an empty string.
